name: Myrcene
description: The most abundant terpene in hemp cultivars. Key component of Nexus's molecular farming platform with applications across functional beverages and wellness products.

name: Limonene
description: Monocyclic monoterpene prevalent in citrus rinds. One of the highest-volume natural flavor compounds with broad market applications from beverages to cleaning products.

name: Linalool
description: Found in lavender and 200+ plant species. High-value fragrance and functional ingredient with demonstrated calming and anti-inflammatory properties.

name: Beta-Caryophyllene
description: Unique sesquiterpene with CB2 receptor binding activity. Potent anti-inflammatory compound with significant pharmaceutical and nutraceutical potential.

name: Pinene
description: Most widely encountered terpene in nature. Industrial-scale applications in cleaning, fragrance, and as a bio-based chemical intermediate.

name: Humulene
description: Isomer of beta-caryophyllene found in hops and ginseng. Key target in Nexus's cultivation program for functional beverage and supplement markets.

name: Terpinolene
description: Complex aromatic monoterpene with antioxidant properties. Valuable in personal care, fragrance blending, and specialty flavor applications.

name: Ocimene
description: Found in mint, orchids, and mangoes. Antiviral and antifungal properties make it a compelling active ingredient for natural product formulations.

name: Bisabolol
description: Prized anti-irritant derived from chamomile. A staple in cosmetic and skincare formulations, now producible at scale through hemp-based molecular farming.

name: Geraniol
description: Monoterpenoid alcohol central to the global fragrance industry. A high-value target compound in Nexus's terpene production program.
